NewsArticle.Title: Current Development Status
NewsArticle.Content:
A new 'hack' out on the internet has allowed players to force the game client to operate at 8 times the normal speed. This has the effect of allowing characters to use skills and spells at an increased rate. As this is a violatin of the user agreement, many of those using the hack have had their accounts blocked for one week.
There is work being done to stop this from being used as well as a script to find those who are using the hacked program. If anyone is found using the hack in the future, their account will be terminated.
